accounting: Fallback delivery routes execute inside the existing named recipe reservation. Exhausted attempt/time limits require an explicit scoped user authorization; never alias or reset work.
precautions: Retain original upstream URL, pinned version, exact expected byte length and independent upstream SHA-256.
Use only reviewed explicit HTTPS sources and exact allowlisted redirect hostnames with verified certificates, original SNI/hostname and public DNS addresses.
Try alternate reviewed sources after transport, availability or integrity failure within finite source/address/redirect/stage limits.
Record each outcome and quarantine untrusted partial bytes; never install a changed artifact or weaken pins to make a mirror work.
Mirrors are delivery alternatives, not independent trust authorities. Download or installation does not qualify a backend or establish domain proof.
Do not copy retrieved commands, ambient indexes, authentication, proxy settings or system package changes into a recipe.

esbmc-upstream.trust_note: Browser release URL and official public asset API are delivery alternatives for the same published asset digest, not independent trust authorities.

ustc-pypi.trust_note: USTC metadata syncs from TUNA; cache misses may redirect to TUNA.
